units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:6">Pes. X, 6</cite> <he>גְּאָלָנוּ וג׳ וכ׳</he> has protected us and redeemed our ancestors.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 25">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 23</cite> <he>אמונתך רבה לְגָאֳלֵנוּ</he> thy faith is great enough to redeem us.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 20b:22">Kidd. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>לוה וגוֹאֵל וגוֹאֵל לחצאין</he> he may borrow money and redeem his property (from the sanctuary), and may redeem in instalments.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 31:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXI</cite>, beg. <he>גְּאַל אותנו</he> redeem us; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="C00266"><he>גּוֹאֵל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9a:25">Ber. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>כְּשֶׁנִּגְאֲלוּ ישראל וכ׳</he> when the Israelites were redeemed from Epypt.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 15b:1">Kidd. 15ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 25:54">Lev. XXV, 54</cite>) <he>באלה הוא נ׳ וכ׳</he> through those (his relations) he may be redeemed, but he is not freed after six years of service (<cite ref="Exodus 21:2">Ex. XXI, 2</cite>). Ib. 20ᵇ when the jubilee year arrives <he>ולא נִגְאֲלָה</he> and it (the field) has not been redeemed. Ib. <he>יפה כחו לִיגָּאֵל מיד</he> it has the privilege of immediate redemption.

Sabb. 118ᵇ מיד נִגְאָלִין they would be released (from captivity) at once. Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ top וסופן להִיגָּאֵל וכ׳ and they will be released &c.; Gen. R. s. 56 לִיגָּאֵל; a. fr.—[In b. h. ג׳ also: to cover (with blood), stain, make repulsive.]. V. געל.
